Title: General availability: Azure Kubernetes Service in India Central

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now generally available in India Central. It's the 19th Azure region to offer the service. In the list of regions, you can see where AKS is available and where it's coming next.

AKS offers a fully managed Kubernetes environment on Azure. It enables customers to spend less time managing infrastructure and more time building applications. To learn more, check out the AKS product page and documentation.
